item.title: Dam failure triggers flooding in Ponte Alta do Bom Jesus, Tocantins, Brazil
item.description: A dam in Ponte Alta do Bom Jesus, southeast of Tocantins, Brazil, suffered a partial failure on the morning of December 19, 2025. Source

item.title: Strong atmospheric river to impact California, up to 500 mm (20 inches) of rain forecast for Sierra Nevada
item.description: Three atmospheric rivers are expected to impact California between December 20 and 25, 2025, producing 250--500 mm (10--20 inches) of rain over the Sierra Nevada and 75--180 mm (3--7 inches) over southern coastal ranges. The strongest system is forecast to peak on December 23–25 with IVT values surpassing 750 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ and AR3–AR4 intensity. Source

item.title: Tornado touches down near Santa Rosa del Monday, Alto Paraná Department, Paraguay
item.description: A tornado touched down in a rural area near Santa Rosa del Monday, Alto Paraná Department, on December 21, 2025, amid severe thunderstorms affecting eastern Paraguay. The phenomenon was documented on video by residents, with reports of localized damage to vegetation and infrastructure but no confirmed casualties. Source

item.title: One dead in Redding as atmospheric river triggers deadly flooding across northern California
item.description: One person was killed and several were rescued after torrential rain from an atmospheric river caused severe flooding in Redding, northern California, on December 21--22, 2025. Rainfall totals above 100 mm (4 inches) overwhelmed storm drains, flooded roads. Source

item.title: Strong M6.5 earthquake hits eastern New Guinea, Papua New Guinea
item.description: A strong earthquake registered by the USGS as M6.5 hit Papua New Guinea at 10:31 UTC (21:31 local time) on December 22, 2025. The agency is reporting a depth of 110.2 km (68 miles). EMSC is reporting M6.4 at a depth of 88 km (55 miles). There is no tsunami threat from this earthquake. Source

item.title: Sand miner trapped by large lahar on Mount Semeru, Indonesia
item.description: A large lahar triggered by heavy rains on Mount Semeru trapped a man in the Regoyo River in East Java, on Sunday, December 21, 2025. Source

item.title: Major incident declared after canal bank failure creates sinkhole near Whitchurch, Shropshire, UK
item.description: A major incident was declared after a canal bank collapsed on the Shropshire Union Canal (Llangollen Canal main line) near Whitchurch, Shropshire, at around 04:22 local time on December 22, 2025, triggering rapid water loss and the formation of a large sinkhole. Multiple narrowboats were affected, with at least two reported to have been pulled into the cavity. Source

item.title: Flash floods cause widespread damage in Indonesia’s Guci hot spring tourist area
item.description: Heavy rains triggered severe flash floods in the Guci hot spring area in Central Java's Tegal Regency on Sunday, December 21, 2025, causing widespread damage. Source

item.title: Floods, heavy snow, and blizzards kill at least eight across 25 provinces in Iran
item.description: At least eight people have died after heavy snow, floods, and blizzards affected more than 25 provinces in Iran between December 15 and 21, 2025, according to the Iranian Red Crescent Society. Source

item.title: At least 5 dead after Mexican Navy plane crashes in Galveston amid foggy conditions
item.description: Five people, including a two-year-old child, were killed after a Mexican Navy plane crashed near Galveston, Texas, amid foggy conditions on Monday, December 22, 2025, while transporting medical patients. At least one person remains missing, with search operations and the investigation continuing. Source
